lines.item: Steel: 2 x 6 m 50x50x3 RHS (side rails, cross-members, mast, carriage) + 2 m 30x30x2 braces + flat bar; zinc-rich primer and topcoat
lines.note: Cut list ~8.5 m of 50x50x3. Replaces G1 + G2 (EUR 105) and the EUR 165 laser/press-brake/galvanise uplift the handover lists as not in the total.

lines.item: One laser-cut order, 4-6 mm S355: comb blade, carriage cheeks, 2 motor plates, 4 mast gussets, caster outriggers, actuator lugs, battery trays (~14 parts)
lines.note: Rev G had 53 made parts and 34 DXF patterns; Rev H has about 14 plates and one tube size. Local quote needed (ATC [nearby town]).

lines.item: Carriage rollers: 8 x 6202-2RS bearings on shoulder bolts
lines.note: Rollers, not slides: lift force 1.2 kN instead of 1.7 kN (statics.json).

lines.item: Deck, motor and battery covers: HDPE / ply offcuts
Nose casters: 2 x 260 mm flat-free swivel casters
lines.note: CONDITIONAL: the donor chair's 200 mm casters work but lose one step case (layout A5 in mech.json). Saving EUR 60 if kept.

lines.item: Tail anti-tip wheels 2 x 100 mm PU
lines.note: Often on the donor chair already.

lines.item: UHMW guide strips on the inner rails 2 x 600x40x10
Donor powerchair: matched 24 V gearmotors + spring brakes, 12.5 in wheels (DoneDeal)
lines.note: Same line and price as Rev G. RISK: used powerchair listings seen on 11 Nov were EUR 209-282 (for-sale.ie). Applies to Rev G equally.

lines.item: Tyre sealant for the donor drive tyres (Slime 473 ml)
Dual 30 A motor driver, Cytron MDDS30 (7-35 V, 30 A cont / 80 A peak)
lines.note: CONDITIONAL: Cytron MDD20A (20 A cont / 60 A peak, 6-30 V) is GBP 37 at The Pi Hut (excerpt). Saving ~EUR 38 once the donor stall current is measured.

lines.item: Reverse-polarity protection for the driver (ideal-diode module, 50 A)
lines.note: The handover lists this as a required substitution not yet in the Rev G total.

lines.item: Wheel encoders x2 (hall quadrature kit)
Lift actuator 24 V, 3000 N, 300 mm stroke, IP65, self-locking
lines.note: Generic 3000 N 300 mm units USD 30-55 (eBay / Alibaba excerpts). Load 1.2 kN: margin 2.5. Replaces the 450 mm tilt actuator the handover calls under-spec.

lines.item: 4 x IP67 roller switches: 2 lip-seated (on the comb), 2 squaring (on the carriage face)
lines.note: Same Aratas D2SW-3L2H switch the G5 report priced at EUR 6.29 each (RS DE).

lines.item: 2 x leg-tip side-gap sensors (VL53L1X-class ToF, potted)
lines.note: Closes the docking loop without relying on the camera: dock_mc.json stress case 82 % -> 99.9 % first try.

lines.item: Actuator current sensor INA219 (bin weight, not-collected, stall)
lines.note: Reads weight directly instead of inferring it from tilt current.

lines.item: Rubber rest pad + comb buffer
2 x 12 V 18 Ah AGM (24 V, 432 Wh nominal)
lines.note: Kung Long WP18-12SHR EUR 46.95 each (ebay.de excerpt). AGM instead of the 12 Ah LiFePO4 (EUR 129.90): no BMS trip on 2 x 45 A step peaks, charges in frost, 11 kg where the layout wants it.

Nose bumper bar + leg-tip bump strips (tape switches)

High-endurance microSD 32 GB (read-only root + UPS HAT do the protecting)

2 x 24 GHz vehicle radar HLK-LD2451 (front, rear)

DC-DC 24->5 V 5 A, RTC, wire, lugs, ferrules, heat-shrink
